      protected void cardUsed()
      Marks the card as used. In this way the game model can understand when to get the next card.

    • initCardPlayers

      public void initCardPlayers() throws IllegalArgumentException
      This method is immediately invoked when the card a new card is extracted. Can be overridden to specify different initialization modes (like reverse player order) We do not use the board players list since in some cards the players order could be different
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException

      Sets the currentPlayer to the next player in the game's turn order. If there are no more players left, set the attribute to an empty optional.

    • useCard

      public abstract EventCard useCard(ActionJSON data) throws IllegalArgumentException
      Parameters:
      data - An ActionJSON containing the data about all actions that the player decided to take when faced with the current event card.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If some data inside the given ActionJSON is incorrect or invalid for the actions the player specified.

    • generateState

      public abstract CardStateJSON generateState()
      Returns:
      Any information that is dynamically updated throughout the event card's lifecycle. (this is what enables support for client-side differential updates)

    • generateStaticState

      public abstract CardStateJSON generateStaticState()
      Returns:

    • setUpdatedPositionsIfNecessary

      protected void setUpdatedPositionsIfNecessary(CardStateJSON cardState, Map<String,Integer> updatedPositions)
      If the map of updatedPositions is not empty, it means that there is something to send to the clients, so we set the field in the cardState.
      This method clears the list after being used (if it wasn't empty to begin with), so that the old data is not sent back to the clients another time
      Parameters:
      cardState - that needs the fields to be set
      updatedPositions - contains the updated positions of each player
